split_rule: Whole episode per chunk. Keep group site-game-ID together in any holdout/split; never split plies or symmetry siblings across folds.
outcome_rule: Actual protocol winner; +1 if observation mover==winner else -1. Raw score is Cyan outcome, not user outcome.
policy_rule: All legal pidx, zero pval, has_pol False. Played moves and winning-game moves are not policy labels.
q_rule: q=z; q_valid False. No search/teacher estimate fabricated.
left_rule: Number of recorded game actions remaining including current action; >=1.
